text.en:
Grants Burning Fists on Melee Kill.
Burning Fists lasts 5 seconds and grants Bonus Melee Damage.

Bonus Melee Damage:
80% | 170% | 390% | 520% | 650%
text.zh-chs:
近战击杀后获得“燃烧之拳”：
“燃烧之拳”持续 5 秒，提供额外近战伤害，可叠加 5 层。

额外近战伤害：
55% | 110% | 165% | 220% | 275%

Grants Burning Fists on (Glaive) Melee Kill, granting Increased (Glaive) Melee Damage for 5 seconds.

(Glaive) Melee Damage Increase at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
55% | 110% | 165% | 220% | 275%
text.zh-chs:
近战击杀后获得“燃烧之拳”：
“燃烧之拳”持续 5 秒，提供额外近战伤害，可叠加 5 层。

额外近战伤害：
55% | 110% | 165% | 220% | 275%

text.en:
Finisher and (Glaive) Melee Kills grant a Stack of Burning Fists up to the maximum of 5 Stacks.

After not having scored further Finisher or (Glaive) Melee Kills for 2 seconds, your Stacks start decaying one at a time over 9.5|10|4|4|3 seconds for the 1st|2nd|... Stacks.

Damage Increases at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• Melee: 55%|110%|165%|220%|275%
• Glaive Melee: 40%|80%|120%|160%|200%
• Weapon: 0%|20%|25%|30%|35% (<link Empowering Buff [#DamageBuffs] />)
